plainLanguage: Section 123 — Disobedience of statutory duty. Ufafanuzi huu unasoma masharti ya kifungu kwa vipengele vyake bila kubadilisha official statutory text.
meaning: Section 123 regulates an offence against public authority. Liability depends on the precise statutory conduct and any express mental element, authority requirement, exception or alternative penalty.
keyPoints: Identify the exact act or omission prohibited.
Establish wilfulness, knowledge, belief or lawful authority where the section expressly requires it.
Check whether the section defers to a different punishment or procedure under another written law.

history.summary: Section 123 appears in Chapter XIII — Miscellaneous Offences Against Public Authority — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Text verified against the official R.E. 2022 government publication.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The offence should be analysed from each express element rather than from the section heading.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Where lawful authority, wilfulness, knowledge, exceptions or alternative statutory penalties matter, they require separate consideration.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na evidence zinatimiza masharti yote ya section 123?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
